facts.text: Jolene shared a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip.

evidence.quote: BTW, I wanted to share this with you. [image: a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip]

facts.text: Jolene designed the notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry due to her love for space and engines.

evidence.quote: I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry.

facts.text: Deborah praised Jolene's creativity, calling it amazing.

evidence.quote: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing!
